description: astro_dock agent hooks: .agents/hook.py runs each workspace package's src/<repo>/<package>/agent_hook.py

hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.agents/hook.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/.agents/hook.py" ] && exec python3 -I "$d/.agents/hook.py" codex; exit 0
